newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Telecel stock seen gaining in Tuesday debut.
newsitem.headline: Telecel stock seen gaining in Tuesday debut.

text.p: Shares in Telecel-Comunicacoes Pessoais (Telecel) should rise sharply at their launch on the Lisbon bourse on Tuesday because of the high level of unsatisfied demand at the public offer to sell (OPV), analysts said.
Analysts said that the shares should easily break 8,100 escudos after being floated on Monday at 7,950 escudos.
"Obviously Telecel is going to pass 8,100 escudos. It could even go to 8,200 escudos," said one analyst at a Lisbon brokerage.

The price of the sale of a 35.6 percent stake in the mobile phone company was at the upper limit of the 6,900-8,100 escudo range set for the operation, one of the largest private flotations ever carried out in Portugal.
The Amorim Banco Espirito Santo groups are selling off the bulk of their holding in the phone company in an operation that will leave the U.S.' AirTouch Communications with a 51 percent stake.
Telecel floated 7,645,000 shares with an additional 10 percent being available as a "green shoe" option.
In the OPV on the bourse, the company sold 600,000 shares with the remaining stock being placed directly with national and international institutional investors.
Offers totalled 124 million shares for the direct sale, while requests at the OPV totalled nearly two million.
